### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_worksheets` | Read list worksheets from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_worksheet` | Read get worksheet from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_tables` | Read list tables from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_table` | Read get table from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_table_rows` | Read list table rows from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_table_columns` | Read list table columns from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_names` | Read list names from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_used_range` | Read get used range from an Excel workbook in a business drive. Use IDs from list\_worksheets or list\_tables. | yes | no | auto |
